results.name: Amberkeepers debut in Level 6 wave 2 with their hint, and come back in L6 W5, W8 and W9
He rears up at foe time 1.6 with threads to the two nearest buds on his row or above, seals them at 2.9, and adds a third at 9.4
A seed clinks off a bead (a glance refund, the bud stays sealed); a crown chain still blooms the bud and its bead melts
A Bee Line, a Sunburst or a Dandelion seed cracks a bead; an uncredited strike pops it quietly
A real seed fired at a bead bounces off it in the ball loop; a real Sunburst cracks the bead and blooms the bud inside
Breaking him (two touches) shatters every bead at once and pays one sun charge; an uncredited strike-out frees them too, unpaid
A credited crack mid-tell makes him flinch: no seal, and the next tell waits 2.6 s
A Lullaby holds his tell; he seals once it is over. He plays the same at 30, 60 and 144 FPS
A bead melts when its bud sinks to 410 or its keeper leaves the board; beads never cost a life; he does
The bot: a keeper is worth 14 + 16 a bead or thread, a bead is never worth a seed, and a shot landing on a bud after its seal is wasted
Level 6 mixes in Rolypoly (W4, W8), Peekaboo Mole (W7) and Echo Bat (W6, W9)
A rolling rolypoly rolls through the amber: it bowls the sealed bud inside (not the bead), the bud blooms by the roll and the bead melts
